title: PVL: Bernadeth Pons still adjusting to indoor game after beach stint

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Returning from the sands to the Taraflex has its pros and cons, and Alas Pilipinas beach volleyball star Bernadeth Pons is patiently taking her time to regain her top form with Creamline in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. After sitting out in the opener in Cebu, Pons returned to action and provided the much-needed spark for the Cool Smashers, who shook off a sluggish start to turn back Galeries Tower, 27-29, 25-18, 25-19, 25-18, and remain unbeaten in two games on Saturday at Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City.
